## Gmail replies → LeadPilot (Phase 5)
Polls Gmail for new inbound mail and posts each message to `POST /api/webhooks/gmail`. The backend matches `from_address` to the contact's business email and marks the latest SENT outreach REPLIED (lead → REPLIED + activity). No LeadPilot IDs needed in Gmail.

Refine the Gmail filter (`q`) to your sending mailbox/label. AI reply classification lands in Phase 7.
